'''Laura Stahl''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Stahl has worked on many iterations of [[Pokémon]] including [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]], [[Pokémon Evolutions]], [[Pokémon Masters EX]], and [[Detective Pikachu Returns]]. Stahl joined the mainline animated series with {{aniseries|HZ}}, where she voiced [[Ult]].
